revisedPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production environment tile env:tile-platform for an original 2D side-scrolling pixel-art game, displayed at exactly 128×32.
Primary request: create one isolated, horizontal, low-saturation stone-and-wood walkway platform. This is a new hybrid masonry-and-timber design, clearly different from a cedar-plank bridge or a grass-topped earth ledge.
Input images: Image 1 is the accepted ground tile, used only for pixel-cluster scale and restrained natural material colors; do not copy its composition or its gold/yellow and ochre saturation. Image 2 is the forest style reference, used only for hard-edged pixel-cluster rendering technique; do not copy its scenery.
Scene/backdrop: one genuine transparent RGBA canvas with no background.
Subject and composition: a single slim, straight, side-view walkway slab on a 4:1 canvas matching the 128×32 display tile. Broad, fitted gray-sage stone pavers form one level walkable cap over a shallow, dark weathered-brown timber fascia. Keep the stone and wood materials clearly distinct with a few broad, simple pixel clusters. The top walking plane is one uninterrupted horizontal line at the very top of the visible artwork, at y=0 across the entire active width; no pixel extends above it. The underside is a single clean, level base with no hanging or protruding pixels.
Tile geometry: center the active artwork within the 4:1 canvas. At 128×32 display size the active columns are x=8 through x=119 inclusive, with full-height, fully transparent 8px gutters at x=0..7 and x=120..127. Keep the first and last active columns identical in RGBA on every row so adjacent tiles meet cleanly at 112px active pitch. Use opaque pixels for the platform and alpha zero for empty space; avoid semi-transparent edge pixels and alpha fringe.
Style/medium: crisp 16-bit pixel-art clusters, hard square edges, no antialiasing, blur, painterly haze, gradients, or smooth rendering. Quiet, sturdy, readable at small gameplay size.
Color palette: restrained gray-sage stone, muted charcoal-gray seams, dark desaturated brown timber; low saturation and modest contrast.
Constraints: no grass, leaves, vines, yellow, gold, lime, red, teal, cyan, neon, glow, bloom, shine, outline, halo, colored fringe, detached pixels, chipped spikes, dangling material, uneven top, uneven bottom, shadow, support, post, rail, rope, scenery, person, creature, item, text, symbol, logo, or watermark.
